decisions.why: Nxstage Versihd, Nxstage System One, and Nxstage System One S are home hemodialysis machines
High Flux, Low Flux, Low Volume Dialyzers, and Sterilization Options are dialyzer filters and consumables for hemodialysis
Multifiltratepro is a CRRT (continuous renal replacement therapy) hemofiltration system for critical care
Crit Line III Monitor is a fluid management and electrolyte monitoring device used in hemodialysis
Liberty Select, Liberty Cycler, and Liberty Ceros are peritoneal dialysis cyclers and equipment for home PD therapy
